title: manuscript-guard stored citation style
description: A journal's citation style as `manuscript-guard style` fetched it from the CSL style repository, kept in profiles/journals/styles/<style>.yaml beside the files. The offline build uses the stored file, and G4 reads this record offline.

style.description: The style's name in the repository, as the profile's references.csl names it.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes as they were fetched.

licence.description: The licence the style names in its <rights>.

citation_format.description: The style's <category citation-format>: the dependent style's own, or else its parent's.

parent.description: For a dependent style, the independent style it formats like, stored beside it.
